description:

Home comes with 1 covered parking spot and 1 exterior storage closet. Landlord pays water and trash. Ideal North Dallas location with quick and easy access to all North Dallas has to offer. Near shopping, entertainment, and great dining options. Spend some time taking in the surrounding greenspaces. Less than 1 mile to Celestial Park and 1 mile to Winnwood Park.
